summary: Iteration 2 regression: 24/25 backend tests pass, frontend crisis UI removal verified end-to-end. CRITICAL backend bug found: /api/assessment-narrative still leaks '1813' and 'zelfmoordlijn' when crisis_flag=true despite the new system prompt instruction. All other regression items (onboarding bullets, admin console auth + UI, settings footer, chat empty state, no 1813 in /chat reply for everyday problems) pass.

critical.issue: When crisis_flag=true, Claude Sonnet 4.5 still produces narrative containing '1813' and 'zelfmoordlijn' (e.g. literal phrase: 'bel de zelfmoordlijn (1813)'). System prompt instruction 'Geen telefoonnummers of hulplijnen vermelden' is not strong enough — and the user-prompt explicitly tells the LLM 'Crisis-flag actief: JA', which seems to override the instruction. This is shown to the user on the test-result screen and violates the iteration-2 requirement to fully remove all 1813 / hulplijn references from the product.

react_native_issues.issue: Still seeing console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (carried over from iteration 1, non-blocking).
Console warning: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing.' on web preview — expected on web, harmless.

action_items: Fix /api/assessment-narrative to never emit '1813' or 'zelfmoordlijn'. Recommended layered fix: (1) Do NOT include 'Crisis-flag actief: JA' in the user_text sent to the LLM — drop the crisis_flag entirely from the prompt; (2) Strengthen NARRATIVE_SYSTEM_PROMPT with an explicit prohibition list: 'Vermeld NOOIT de woorden 1813, zelfmoordlijn, hulplijn, of telefoonnummers — ook niet bij hoge scores.'; (3) Add a defensive post-processing step in assessment_narrative() that strips/replaces '1813' and 'zelfmoordlijn' from the model output before returning.

Also reconsider whether NarrativeRequest.crisis_flag should still exist as a field at all (currently still used by /app/frontend/app/zelftesten/[id]/index.tsx when POSTing). If kept, it should not be forwarded to the LLM.
(Optional polish carried over) Replace deprecated `pointerEvents` prop with `style.pointerEvents`.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 346: f-string sends 'Crisis-flag actief: {JA|nee}' into the user prompt — this directly cues the LLM to add crisis safety language that contradicts the system prompt's 'geen hulplijnen' rule. Conflicting signals to the LLM almost guarantee 1813 will leak.

Belt-and-suspenders: when product policy is 'never emit token X', always add a deterministic post-filter on the server in addition to prompt engineering. LLM compliance with negative instructions is unreliable.

/app/frontend/src/data/assessments.ts line 2 still contains a comment 'Crisis-hulplijn: 1813 (Zelfmoordlijn België).' Code comment only, but conceptually drift from the new product policy — consider deleting.

rca_of_issue: The narrative leaks '1813' because (a) NARRATIVE_SYSTEM_PROMPT instructs the model NOT to mention hulplijnen, but (b) assessment_narrative() injects the literal string 'Crisis-flag actief: JA' into the user message. Telling an LLM 'crisis is active' while also telling it 'never mention crisis lines' is a contradictory instruction set — Claude 4.5 reliably resolves the contradiction by emitting safety language. Reproduction: POST /api/assessment-narrative with crisis_flag=true → response.narrative contains 'zelfmoordlijn (1813)'. Mitigation: stop forwarding crisis_flag to the LLM AND add a deterministic regex post-filter as backup.
